title: Growable Stack on a Raw Buffer
hints: Two numbers, not one: `size_` is how many ints are in use, `cap_` is how many fit in the block `data_` points to. `push` may only write `data_[size_]` when `size_ < cap_`, so grow first: `if (size_ == cap_) grow();`.

`grow()` is problem 3 again with `int`: `new_cap = cap_ ? cap_ * 2 : 1`, allocate `new int[new_cap]`, copy the first `size_` values (not `cap_`), `delete[]` the old block, then point `data_` at the new one and set `cap_`. `pop` must not free or shrink anything; just decrement `size_`.
